course_summary:
ISEN 660 / CHEN 660, SENG 660 | Risk Engineering | Fall 2025
Instructor: Neil Diaz Martinez | nodiaz@tamu.edu
Meets: N/A | ONLINE
Grading: Quizzes, homework, assignments [20%], Unit 1 Evaluation: Systems Engineering [20%], Unit 2 Evaluation: Risk Management [20%], Unit 3 Evaluation: Probabilistic Risk Assessment - PRA [10%], Unit 4 Evaluation: Reliability [30%] — A: 90-100, B: 80-90, C: 70-80, D: 60-70, F: less than 60
Topics: ISO 31000:2018, IEC 31010:2019, MBSE, SysML, Probabilistic Risk Assessment (PRA), hazard identification, hazard assessment, mitigation strategies, reliability modeling, System Reliability Analysis, Reliability of Repairable Systems, Elements of Component Reliability, risk analysis, risk assessment, risk management, Systems Engineering discipline, international standards, engineering systems, industrial facilities, qualitative approaches, quantitative approaches, foundations, processes, use case, additional topics
Tools: Canvas, MATLAB, R, Excel, Python, Eclipse Papyrus
Prerequisites: Graduate classification
